summary: The hosts are strongly bullish on Bitcoin following the monthly breakout above 23K, emphasizing this as a trend-forming breakout that should not be faded with deep pullbacks. They view daily invalidation below 28K and monthly/weekly invalidations below 23K-24K as key levels to watch. Altcoins are largely struggling against BTC, though selective opportunities exist in assets showing relative strength like XRP (up 58% vs BTC). Regulatory headwinds continue with CFTC suing Binance, but hosts view this as manageable compared to BitMEX scenario. Overall, the market is Bitcoin-centric and bullish until proven otherwise.
